req.title: Blog post title required on update
req.statement: The system shall reject POST /<id>/update with a missing title, rendering an error.
triggers: blog post title required on update

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that POST /<id>/update must reject requests with a missing title by rendering an error (HTTP 2xx with error content, not a redirect). We need: (1) a positive case where a valid title is provided and the update succeeds, (2) a negative case where title is empty/missing and the error is rendered, (3) a boundary case where title is exactly one character (minimum non-empty). We use pre-loaded data: user Rahul (id=1, password='stone') owns post id=2. The update endpoint flashes 'Title is required.' and re-renders the form (HTTP 200) instead of redirecting (HTTP 302) when title is missing. Mutations targeted: status code exact match (200 vs 302), error message string match, boolean negation of `if not title`, redirect vs re-render path.

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_update_post_with_valid_title_succeeds():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    r = client.post('/2/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated body'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

test_update_post_with_valid_title_succeeds()
